rules: Read 56/56 consolidated rules §33 and current Google Doc V16 §§54–56 including R29 loader-only override; historical original not independently verified verbatim
problem: Google Docs endOfSegmentLocation inserts before terminal paragraph newline. Raw append can join a leading RunID to preceding text; prior ALREADY_PRESENT/READBACK_PASS accepted entry substring even when RunID identity was not a separate token, including when another matching RunID existed elsewhere.
code_fix: Preserve delimiter before insertion as needed; bind idempotence and post-write readback to the exact matched entry occurrence AND immutable RunID token boundaries. Ambiguous pre-existing fused match -> RUNID_BOUNDARY_HOLD, no write. No retries added.

new_lesson: RunID integrity requires verified token boundaries at the SAME full-entry occurrence, not a substring match nor an unrelated RunID elsewhere.
